question: Does the international-site Alibaba Cloud Agent Sandbox (Agent Sandbox, Flash/Container Edition) carry the same China-site real-name identity gate recorded in compute/alibaba-agentrun, or does the international site accept an email address and a payment method?
why: The existing compute/alibaba-agentrun record already holds the Alibaba Cloud Agent Sandbox offer (Flash/Container Edition). Its international billing page read 2026-11-25 confirms the same 15 GiB free disk allowance and per-second billing but states no sign-up requirement; the record's national-id gate comes from China account-registration pages. The unit scope allows no changes to that record. An agent must not register, so the gate cannot be settled here.
